name: Corgi FTSE 7-10 Year U.S. Treasury Bond ETF
name_en: Corgi FTSE 7-10 Year U.S. Treasury Bond ETF
desc: Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in U.S. dollar-denominated U.S. Treasury bonds with a remaining maturity of at least seven years and less than ten years that comprise the index. It is non-diversified.
